criteria.commensurate: Judged proportionate. The fixes change every hamlet's fan and ring bunds; the cost falls on a few rolls (20 hh seed 4 +1.9 s / +32%, reference seed 25 +0.9 s / +26%, 10 hh seeds 39 and 47 +0.3-0.4 s) while 40 hh falls 3.8%. The worst roll was cut from +47% by the way round already taken. This is a judgment on correctness gained against seconds, not new functionality.
criteria.necessary: Yes. The increase comes from research corrections: the fork triangle on a city's grain only (0010), no sideways ring step (0014), and wave 9's yard-step hold (E3). Reverting any of them puts the map back out of line with its research. No search code was added; the web's existing searches run deeper on the moved layouts (reach.settle_field 242 candidates against 10 on 20 hh seed 4).
criteria.no_way_around: Measured, with nothing cheap left. Taken: the lawful-ground test asks the crossing last (3cb19c982, output identical; 20 hh seed 4 8.8 to 7.9 s). Tried and recovering nothing material: the flooded rings' boxes computed once (0.15 s), a crossing_deck memo (18 of 245 calls hit), and bund.clear with the fixture test last and the quads built once per RunOnBlocks (identical output, 8.0-8.1 s against 7.9 s). The rest is the field-way and bund-way searches running deeper on the new layout, which only a change to the searches themselves could cut, not a cheap fix.

note: Band 3 stands: 20 hh seed 4 +31.7% and reference seed 25 +25.6% are over the 20% per-seed line, and the GM's own perf-signoff is still owed; this record does not grant it.
